O60240.Function: Modulator of adipocyte lipid metabolism. Coats lipid storage droplets to protect them from breakdown by hormone-sensitive lipase (HSL).

O60262.Full name: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(O) subunit gamma-7
O60262.Function: Guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins) are involved as a modulator or transducer in various transmembrane signaling systems. The beta and gamma chains are required for the GTPase activity, for replacement of GDP by GTP, and for G protein-effector interaction.

O75159.Alternative names: Cytokine-inducible SH2 protein 6; Cytokine-inducible SH2-containing protein 5

O75342.Function: Catalyzes the regio and stereo-specific incorporation of a single molecule of dioxygen into free and esterified polyunsaturated fatty acids generating lipid hydroperoxides that can be further reduced to the corresponding hydroxy species. O75582.Alternative names: 90 kDa ribosomal protein S6 kinase 5; Nuclear mitogen- and stress-activated protein kinase 1; RSK-like protein kinase
O75582.Function: Serine/threonine-protein kinase that is required for the mitogen or stress-induced phosphorylation of the transcription factors CREB1 and ATF1 and for the regulation of the transcription factors RELA, STAT3 and ETV1/ER81, and that contributes to gene activation by histone phosphorylation and functions in the regulation of inflammatory genes. Phosphorylates CREB1 and ATF1 in response to mitogenic or stress stimuli such as UV-C irradiation, epidermal growth factor (EGF) and anisomycin.

O75688.Function: Enzyme with a broad specificity. Dephosphorylates CDK2 and CDK6 in vitro.

O75791.Alternative names: Adapter protein GRID; GRB-2-like protein; GRBLG; GRBX; Grf40 adapter protein; Growth factor receptor-binding protein; Hematopoietic cell-associated adapter protein GrpL; P38; Protein GADS; SH3-SH2-SH3 adapter Mona

O95865.Function: Putative hydrolase with unknown substrate (Probable). Does not hydrolyze N(G),N(G)-dimethyl-L-arginine (ADMA) which acts as an inhibitor of NOS.

O95999.Function: Plays a key role in both adaptive and innate immune signaling by bridging CARD domain-containing proteins to immune activation. P01100.Alternative names: Cellular oncogene fos; Fos proto-oncogene, AP-1 transcription factor subunit; G0/G1 switch regulatory protein 7; Proto-oncogene c-Fos; Transcription factor AP-1 subunit c-Fos
P01100.Function: Nuclear phosphoprotein which forms a tight but non-covalently linked complex with the JUN/AP-1 transcription factor. In the heterodimer, FOS and JUN/AP-1 basic regions each seems to interact with symmetrical DNA half sites.

P01133.Function: EGF stimulates the growth of various epidermal and epithelial tissues in vivo and in vitro and of some fibroblasts in cell culture. P01275.Function: Plays a key role in glucose metabolism and homeostasis. Regulates blood glucose by increasing gluconeogenesis and decreasing glycolysis.

P01308.Function: Hormone secreted by pancreatic islet beta cells, that is the principal anabolic regulator of glucose, lipid, and protein metabolism and the central controller of blood glucose homeostasis. Acts by binding to and activating the insulin receptor INSR, a receptor tyrosine kinase, triggering INSR autophosphorylation and recruitment/phosphorylation of insulin receptor substrate proteins IRS1 and IRS2, which activate the downstream PI3K/AKT and RAS/MAPK signaling cascades.

P01375.Alternative names: Cachectin; TNF-alpha; Tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 2
P01375.Function: Cytokine that binds to TNFRSF1A/TNFR1 and TNFRSF1B/TNFBR, activating the tumor necrosis factor-mediated (TNF) signaling pathway. P01579.Function: Type II interferon produced by immune cells such as T-cells and NK cells that plays crucial roles in antimicrobial, antiviral, and antitumor responses by activating effector immune cells and enhancing antigen presentation. P01854.Alternative names: Ig epsilon chain C region; Ig epsilon chain C region ND

P01857.Alternative names: Ig gamma-1 chain C region; Ig gamma-1 chain C region EU; Ig gamma-1 chain C region KOL; Ig gamma-1 chain C region NIE

P01861.Function: Constant region of immunoglobulin (Ig) heavy chains. Igs are membrane-bound or secreted glycoproteins produced by B lymphocytes.

HMGCR is the main target of statins, a class of cholesterol-lowering drugs

P04049.Function: Serine/threonine-protein kinase that acts as a regulatory link between the membrane-associated Ras GTPases and the MAPK/ERK cascade, and this critical regulatory link functions as a switch determining cell fate decisions including proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, survival and oncogenic transformation. RAF1 activation initiates a mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) cascade that comprises a sequential phosphorylation of the dual-specific MAPK kinases (MAP2K1/MEK1 and MAP2K2/MEK2) and the extracellular signal-regulated kinases (MAPK3/ERK1 and MAPK1/ERK2).

P04141.Function: Cytokine that stimulates the growth and differentiation of hematopoietic precursor cells from various lineages, including granulocytes, macrophages, eosinophils and erythrocytes

P04424.Function: Catalyzes the reversible cleavage of L-argininosuccinate to fumarate and L-arginine, an intermediate step reaction in the urea cycle mostly providing for hepatic nitrogen detoxification into excretable urea as well as de novo L-arginine synthesis in nonhepatic tissues. Essential regulator of intracellular and extracellular L-arginine pools.

P05089.Function: Catalyzes the final step of the urea cycle by hydrolyzing L-arginine into urea, a nitrogenous waste product, and L-ornithine, a precursor to proline and polyamines; the urea cycle occurs primarily in the liver and, to a lesser extent, in the kidneys

P05108.Alternative names: CYPXIA1; Cholesterol desmolase; Cytochrome P450 11A1; Cytochrome P450(scc)

P05112.Alternative names: B-cell stimulatory factor 1; Binetrakin; Lymphocyte stimulatory factor 1; Pitrakinra
P05112.Function: Cytokine secreted primarily by mast cells, T-cells, eosinophils, and basophils that plays a role in regulating antibody production, hematopoiesis and inflammation, and the development of effector T-cell responses. Induces the expression of class II MHC molecules on resting B-cells.

P05113.Alternative names: B-cell differentiation factor I; Eosinophil differentiation factor; T-cell replacing factor
P05113.Function: Homodimeric cytokine expressed predominantly by T-lymphocytes and NK cells that plays an important role in the survival, differentiation, and chemotaxis of eosinophils. Also acts on activated and resting B-cells to induce immunoglobulin production, growth, and differentiation.

P05412.Alternative names: Activator protein 1; Proto-oncogene c-Jun; Transcription factor AP-1 subunit Jun; V-jun avian sarcoma virus 17 oncogene homolog; p39
P05412.Function: Transcription factor that recognizes and binds to the AP-1 consensus motif 5'-TGA[GC]TCA-3'. Heterodimerizes with proteins of the FOS family to form an AP-1 transcription complex, thereby enhancing its DNA binding activity to the AP-1 consensus sequence 5'-TGA[GC]TCA-3' and enhancing its transcriptional activity.

P06213.Function: Receptor tyrosine kinase which mediates the pleiotropic actions of insulin. Binding of insulin leads to phosphorylation of several intracellular substrates, including, insulin receptor substrates (IRS1, 2, 3, 4), SHC, GAB1, CBL and other signaling intermediates.

P06734.Alternative names: BLAST-2; C-type lectin domain family 4 member J; Fc-epsilon-RII; Immunoglobulin E-binding factor; Lymphocyte IgE receptor
P06734.Full name: Low affinity immunoglobulin epsilon Fc receptor
P06734.Function: Low-affinity receptor for immunoglobulin E (IgE) and CR2/CD21. Has essential roles in the regulation of IgE production and in the differentiation of B cells.

P06737.Function: Allosteric enzyme that catalyzes the rate-limiting step in glycogen catabolism, the phosphorolytic cleavage of glycogen to produce glucose-1-phosphate, and plays a central role in maintaining cellular and organismal glucose homeostasis

P06744.Alternative names: Autocrine motility factor; D-hexose-6-phosphate anomerase; Glucose-6-phosphate C2-epimerase; Neuroleukin; Phosphoglucose isomerase; Phosphohexose isomerase; Sperm antigen 36
P06744.Function: Isomerase that catalyzes the conversion of alpha-D-glucose-6-phosphate to beta-D-fructose-6-phosphate, the second step in glycolysis, and the reverse reaction in gluconeogenesis, within the cytoplasm. Also shows C2-epimerase activity, interconverting D-glucose-6-phosphate (G6P) and D-mannose-6-phosphate (M6P).

P07203.Alternative names: Cellular glutathione peroxidase; Phospholipid-hydroperoxide glutathione peroxidase GPX1
P07203.Function: Catalyzes the reduction of hydroperoxides in a glutathione-dependent manner thus regulating cellular redox homeostasis. Can reduce small soluble hydroperoxides such as H2O2, cumene hydroperoxide and tert-butyl hydroperoxide, as well as several fatty acid-derived hydroperoxides.

P07332.Alternative names: Feline sarcoma/Fujinami avian sarcoma oncogene homolog; Proto-oncogene c-Fes; Proto-oncogene c-Fps; p93c-fes
